prompt.title: Teach it to learn it
prompt.text: Pick each chapter's one idea you most want to keep, put it in your own words, and plan to explain it to someone within the next two days. Teaching it back is what turns a good idea you read into one you actually own.
prompt.whyItMatters: Explaining something out loud, to a real person, exposes what you actually understood versus what you only recognised. A short commitment with a deadline is what makes that happen instead of staying a good intention.
